name: Geotechnical
description: Strong on ground risk identification and early subsurface strategy.
starting_bonus: Lower initial risk index and better geotechnical recruitment odds.
starting_penalty: Slightly lower initial public approval due to technical-first focus.

name: Structural
description: Strong on design quality, constructability, and integrity assurance.
starting_bonus: Improved outcomes on bridge and station packages.
starting_penalty: Less flexibility on early social planning tasks.

name: Transport
description: Strong systems view across operations, rail interfaces, and integration.
starting_bonus: Better systems integration and trial operations readiness.
starting_penalty: Higher sensitivity to late civil design changes.

name: Construction / Project Management
description: Strong on delivery control, sequencing discipline, and cost governance.
starting_bonus: Improved staffing morale and cost-control candidate odds.
starting_penalty: Slight early planning blind spot in environmental detail.

name: Environmental / Planning
description: Strong on approvals, heritage, and community-facing delivery.
starting_bonus: Higher initial public approval and planning talent bias.
starting_penalty: Slightly higher early engineering risk exposure.
